newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Zaire's Kabila to meet Mandela in Cape Town.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Kabila to meet Mandela in Cape Town.

text.p: Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila will meet South African President Nelson Mandela in Cape Town on Wednesday evening, government sources said.
Kabila would meet Mandela at his Cape Town residence to explore ways to bring peace to Zaire, one senior source said.

The source said Mandela, with the approval of other African leaders he had consulted, was trying to arrange a direct meeting in South Africa between Kabila and ailing Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko.
Witnesses said Kabila left Zaire's Lubumbashi airport for South Africa earlier in the day, but there was no word on the movements of the Zairean president.
No definite arrangement had been made for a meeting between the two rivals, but the source predicted it could take place by the weekend.
Sources said the U.N. special representative on Zaire, Mohamed Sahnoun, had arrived with a delegation in Cape Town earlier in the day.
